module.name: Quantum Substrate Model
module.purpose: Defines a structured extension of substrate-level modeling in which regime structure, dimensional constraints, and interaction domains are explicitly declared — formalizing how multiple substrate regimes may coexist, transition, or interact without embedding empirical claims or domain-specific semantics.
